title: SLO communications & onboarding sprint notes — Apr 2026
summary: Working notes for a two-week sprint focused on preparing a lightweight communications and onboarding kit for service owners and platform partners to adopt SLOs. This doc captures meeting notes, proposed sessions, rough comms copy, and an experiment plan to measure adoption velocity.
objectives: Create a 1-pager and slide deck that explains the SLO model and owner responsibilities in plain language
Run three 30-minute SLO literacy sessions (brown-bag style) for Product, Platform, and Support
Prototype a shadow-oncall rotation to surface operational gaps before full SLO rollout
Define measurable adoption metrics and a simple heatmap to prioritize follow-up work
key_milestones: Apr 05: Kickoff — align cross-functional sponsors and decide success metrics
Apr 07: Draft 1-pager and comms email copy — internal review
Apr 09: Host 1st literacy session (Platform) + feedback capture
Apr 12: Finalize slide deck and example SLO templates for two services
Apr 14: Begin 2-week shadow rotation for two critical services
Apr 18: Run adoption metrics query and produce heatmap; retro and next-step list
stakeholders_and_roles: Maya Chen — sprint lead, coordinates content and sessions
Diego Alvarez — SRE liaison, leads shadow rotations and technical Q&A
Priya Nair — Product partner, helps recruit service owners and aligns priorities
Ethan Brooks — Observability owner, provides dashboards and metric hooks
Lina Park — Developer experience, owns playbook templates and onboarding flow
onboarding_workstreams: Comms kit: 1-pager, slide deck, short FAQ, and email templates
Training: three 30-minute sessions with live Q&A and a recorded version
Templates: SLO & SLA starter templates (latency P95, error budget burn, ticketing triggers)
Shadow ops: two-week observation for two services to capture incomplete signals and gap stories
Measurement: simple queries to extract percent services with defined SLOs, percent with alerting tied to error budget
sprint_tasks: Draft slides + speaker notes (Lina) — due Apr 08
Create onboarding checklist (Priya + Diego) — due Apr 09
Instrument two services for shadow rotation (Ethan) — start Apr 10
Collect feedback form and synthesize into action log (everyone) — Apr 14
Publish recorded session and commute to docs (Maya) — Apr 15
communication_plan: Targeted, low-friction outreach. Week 0: one short email from SRE and Product sponsors to service owners announcing the pilot and value proposition. Week 1: invite to 30-minute literacy sessions and include link to 1-pager + FAQ. Use Slack channel #sre-slo-pilot for async Q&A and an office-hours calendar block for hands-on help. Follow-up after shadow rotation with a concise heatmap and recommended next actions.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Service owners won’t prioritize 30-minute sessions — Mitigation: timebox sessions at 30 minutes, record, and get executive sponsor to highlight importance
Risk: Observability gaps prevent realistic SLOs — Mitigation: define temporary proxy metrics and mark them as intermediate artifacts; escalate critical gaps to infra backlog
Risk: Too much jargon in comms — Mitigation: test drafts with a non-SRE partner (Product manager) and iterate until plain-language score is high
Risk: Shadow rotation burns out small teams — Mitigation: limit rotation to observation only for first run, no paging responsibility, keep duty duration short
acceptance_criteria: At least 8 service owners have attended a literacy session or watched the recording
Two production services completed a shadow rotation with documented gaps and one short follow-up ticket each
SLO playbook 1-pager and slide deck published in Confluence with clear templates
A heatmap showing coverage and gap areas produced and shared with exec sponsors
next_steps: Incorporate feedback from Platform session (Apr 09) into comms kit — owner: Maya
Open tickets for top 5 observability gaps discovered during shadow rotation — owner: Diego
Schedule two additional 15-minute office hours sessions for service owners next week — owner: Lina
Run a lightweight survey to measure comprehension and intent to adopt after sessions — owner: Priya
